description: Name the agent (Ringo by default; keeping the name counts), pick its voice from `voices`, and set how it answers when your person calls their own line (greeting). Free; change any time. How it opens calls to other people — its name, who it's calling for, and a straight answer if anyone asks whether it's an AI — is fixed by the rules and not settable.

greeting.description: Exactly what it says when your person calls, e.g. 'Good evening, sir. Jarvis here. How can I help?' ({first} and {name} fill in).

voice.description: A voice from the voices tool, e.g. daniel.

name: name_my_agent
title: Name my agent
